scope: Read-only original installed iOS14b5 classification for owned app physically at /Applications/InfernoProbe.app. No signature/profile assertion, code patch, registration trial or guest mutation.

sources.installd_origin: Unchanged usr/libexec/installd extracted read-only from official-os.raw to external app-classification-inspection directory. MobileInstallation addresses are original mapped System cache VAs. CoreServices addresses below are image-relative offsets, not fabricated runtime VAs.

current_owned_record: Launcher reads owned Info.plist and adds Path only. No ApplicationType currently supplied. Actual proxyUser is fallback, not explicit metadata.

Switchtable0x100019fd8 maps type1 to0x100019f64 returning literalSystem. Types2/Internal,4/User,5/CoreServices are distinct; no blanket Appleidentity claim follows from type1.

separate_path_trust: CoreServices _LSPathIsTrustedaf2c0 accepts /Applications/ prefix and callerb0f7c..90 sets a separate root-owned path flag. This is not the ApplicationType classifier and was not used as sole justification.
minimal_candidate: For exactly the owned, verified /Applications/InfernoProbe.app whose identifier and app extension are known, adding ApplicationType=System to the owned registration dictionary reproduces original MIBundle location classification. Keep org.inferno identity, actual path, plain owned ad-hoc signature and all other metadata unchanged. Do not set signerIdentity, signatureVersion, profileValidated, UPPValidated, trust, team identifier or Appleidentity fields. Parent must review this evidence before a bounded execution experiment.
limits: Classification affects original FrontBoard validation policy (native evidence012c9936ca). This evidence establishes truthful normal path classification, not successful launch or correctness of all direct-registration metadata. No System classification is justified for arbitrary Data paths or bundles outside exact owned System installation.
